title: Migrate core ledger database to PostgreSQL 16
author: aarav-dev
body: Resolves RFC-007. After team review and performance benchmarks, we decided against MongoDB and migrated the transaction ledger to PostgreSQL 16.

review_comments.author: meera-lead
review_comments.body: Postgres schema looks solid. Confirmed rollback script works.

title: Webhook delivery engine retry policy update
author: aarav-dev
body: Updates webhook dispatcher max retry limit to 5. Supersedes stale runbook guidance of 3 attempts.

review_comments.author: dev-contractor
review_comments.body: Code sets max_attempts=5. Note: remember to update runbook-webhooks.md too.

title: Spike: Evaluate DynamoDB for transaction ledger
author: dev-contractor
body: Spike to evaluate DynamoDB single-table design. Abandoned.

review_comments.author: aarav-dev
review_comments.body: Closing this spike without merging. Postgres meets our latency SLA.

title: Switch to stateless JWT tokens
author: aarav-dev
body: Abandons Redis session caching proposed in ADR-003. We are moving to stateless JWT tokens with HMAC-SHA256 signatures.

review_comments.author: meera-lead
review_comments.body: Approved. Stateless JWT completely replaces the ADR-003 Redis proposal.
